name: rawsens
description: Open-source aim sensitivity calibration for Windows.

scripts.build:desktop: pnpm electrobun:prepare && pnpm build:web && electrobun build --env=stable
scripts.build:desktop:dev: pnpm electrobun:prepare && pnpm build:web && electrobun build --env=dev
scripts.check: pnpm electrobun:prepare && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build:web
scripts.dev: pnpm electrobun:prepare && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail "vite --port 5173" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && electrobun dev --watch"
